column3: Content Security Policy header not set
Forms are Server Actions (Origin-header CSRF check) or Auth.js (double-submit token)
Same as 10202: Server Actions check the Origin header instead of a form token
The anonymous /dashboard 307 carries the public page shell only (no user data)
Vercel's CDN adds ACAO * to public static files only; scripts/smoke.mjs fails if any page or API sends CORS allow headers
Same as 10098 (static files only); smoke.mjs enforces no CORS on pages and APIs
Proxy disclosure: says the site is behind Vercel's edge, which is public
COEP not set: no cross-origin isolation needed; COOP and CORP are set
Next.js answers a 500 with an opaque digest when a Server Action's argument list itself is malformed (before app code runs); app code answers 200/400
No MongoDB; strict input schemas answer differently to [$ne] keys
